title: Create Aeronautics AirpresureFix
description: Overrides the default Sable physics engine with a smooth, real-world barometric pressure curve. Adds a 1:6.67 scaled atmosphere with a true Kármán line boundary at Y=15,000.
body: By default the Create Aeronautics physics engine cuts air pressure about at Y=320, causing heavy or realistically balanced aircraft to stall out almost immediately.This datapack fixes early stalls by replacing the harsh default pressure drop with a smooth, mathematically accurate barometric curve based on real-world atmospheric data. It scales to the edge of space to a true vacuum at Y=15,000.
